findings.finding: GitHub currently reports main protected=false. PR #28 provides a dry-run-by-default administrative operator, desired ruleset and an Actions workflow, but the first application still requires a repository token with Administration: write and API read-back.
findings.disposition: Separate merge gate. Do not merge PR #28 until branch protection/ruleset is actually applied, all required contexts are read back, and a negative enforcement test passes.

findings.finding: GOV-02..GOV-12 are logical AI Functional Delegate designations only. Their runtimes, models, tool scopes and audit stores are not provisioned/active.
findings.disposition: No production operations may be attributed to these delegates until A1-A8 evidence passes.

findings.finding: No production deployment, WORM storage, live secrets manager/KMS, backup schedule, tested restore, failover or production security evidence is present.
findings.disposition: Production state remains NOT_DEPLOYED; DR NOT_TESTED; production security NOT_VERIFIED.

findings.finding: The development toolchain pins direct dependencies but does not yet provide a fully transitive, hash-locked dependency artifact.
findings.disposition: Do not call the environment hermetic or bit-for-bit reproducible; add a verified hashed lock before supply-chain assurance claims.

findings.finding: The KM 1 worker is an allowlisted outbox foundation with no business capability handlers registered. The operational Registry, Gateway, managed Runtime, Evaluation and Synchronization services are deliberately not implemented in this PR.
findings.disposition: Do not claim end-to-end capability invocation or platform service operation. Proceed to KM 2 only after KM 1 acceptance.

findings.finding: The Indonesia legal memo is an issue-spotting research baseline, not entity formation, PSE registration, tax advice, a legal opinion or evidence of third-party IP rights.
findings.disposition: No external contract, marketplace, payment or customer-data operation is authorized by this PR.

limitations: This is a correlation-limited AI assurance report, not independent model/provider certification.
GOV-11 has been designated as a logical profile but has not been provisioned as a separate execution runtime.
A successful CI check proves only the named workflow's tests on its exact commit; it does not prove production deployment, DR, WORM, legal compliance or platform-service operation.
disposition: The reviewed change set is acceptable with caveats as a KM 1 foundation and governance implementation proposal. Merge, KM 0/KM 1 closure, production release and downstream KM 2 work remain on HOLD until their separate gates pass.
